plugin.name: Trailhead
plugin.author: Rodarvus
plugin.purpose: Report S&D area start rooms and mapper distance from Aylor recall.
plugin.description:
Trailhead reports Search & Destroy area start rooms and their mapper distance from the configured Aylor recall source.
Commands: trailhead Show cached area table. trailhead areas Group cached areas by best distance. trailhead refresh [area] Re-read S&D and mapper distances. trailhead missing Show only missing/unreachable areas. trailhead area <key> Show one area. trailhead monitor [on|off] Record observed mapper walks. Default: off. trailhead walks [limit] Show longest confirmed mapper walks. trailhead walks all [n] Include unconfirmed/search observations. trailhead source [room] Show or set the source room. Default: 32418. trailhead help Show help.
Short alias: th
